conditional_visibility.scope: selected path and earlier saved guided individual answers; blocks may also use the current saved question

guided_experience.shared_steps: module.step_templates referenced by step.use_template with stable step.id and optional overrides

guided_offline_queue.retry: transactional durable mutation receipts for evidence and answers; optimistic revision conflicts require review
guided_offline_queue.http_errors: status preserved including non-JSON bodies; never classified as offline
guided_offline_queue.confirmation: positive revision and exact mutation ID required
guided_offline_queue.rebase_scope: same document origin only; other tab stale queued writes require conflict review

guided_experience.preview_state: temporary in-memory; no production progress writes
